content: .{@-मातृक@} {%a.%} [न देवो मेघो माता वृष्टिकारकः यस्य] not rained upon; (<ab>lit.</ab>) not having the god of rain as mother to suckle or water; hence (artificially) supplied with the water of rivers, canals <ab>&c.</ab>, irrigated; वितन्वति क्षेममदेवमातृकाश्चिराय तस्मिन्कुरवश्चकासते <ls>Ki. 1. 17</ls>.
